  --navy: #F5F4EF; --navy-mid: #FAFAF7; --navy-light: #F1EFE8; --navy-border: #E6E1D6;
  --brand: #1F3864; --brand-blue: #2B4A7A; --teal: #2E7D74; --teal-light: #70C49C;
  --teal-pale: #D6F0E8; --cream: #FAFAF7; --white: #20242B; --muted: #9A8F78;
  --text-light: #3A372F; --text-mid: #5F5A50; --green: #21823F; --red: #C0492F;
  --ink: #20242B; --navy-accent: #1F3864;
  --font-body: 'DM Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  --font-heading: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
  --glass-bg: rgba(250,250,247,0.72);
  --glass-border: rgba(46,125,116,0.18);

#pacerai-homepage * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
#pacerai-homepage { font-family: var(--font-body); background: var(--navy); color: var(--text-light); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.65; scroll-behavior: smooth; }

/* ─── NAV ─── */

#pacerai-homepage .nav-logo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; text-decoration: none; }
#pacerai-homepage .nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; list-style: none; }
#pacerai-homepage .nav-links > li { position: relative; }
#pacerai-homepage .nav-links > li > a { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: var(--text-mid); text-decoration: none; border-radius: 6px; transition: color 0.2s, background 0.2s; }

#pacerai-homepage .dropdown { display: none; position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); background: var(--navy-mid); border: 1px solid var(--navy-border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; padding-top: 28px; min-width: 520px; box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); z-index: 200; }

#pacerai-homepage .dropdown-col-label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--teal); padding-bottom: 10px; margin-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--navy-border); }

#pacerai-homepage .dropdown a:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); }
#pacerai-homepage .dropdown .d-icon { width: 32px; height: 32px; flex-shrink: 0; background: var(--navy-light); border: 1px solid var(--navy-border); border-radius: 7px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: var(--teal); }
#pacerai-homepage .dropdown .d-text .d-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--white); display: block; line-height: 1.3; }
#pacerai-homepage .dropdown .d-text .d-desc { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 2px; }
#pacerai-homepage .single-dropdown { min-width: 220px; }

#pacerai-homepage .single-dropdown a:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: var(--white); }
#pacerai-homepage .nav-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
#pacerai-homepage .btn-ghost { padding: 8px 18px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-light); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--navy-border); border-radius: 7px; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.2s; }

#pacerai-homepage .btn-teal { padding: 9px 20px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; background: var(--teal); border: none; border-radius: 7px; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.2s; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
#pacerai-homepage .btn-teal:hover { background: var(--teal-light); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(39,137,154,0.35); }
#pacerai-homepage .mobile-menu-btn { display: none; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 8px; z-index: 101; }
#pacerai-homepage .mobile-menu-btn span { display: block; width: 22px; height: 2px; background: var(--text-light); border-radius: 2px; transition: all 0.3s; }

/* ─── HERO ─── */
#pacerai-homepage .hero { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; padding: 160px 24px 80px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
#pacerai-homepage .hero-bg { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0; background: radial-gradient(ellipse 900px 600px at 50% 30%, rgba(46,125,116,0.07) 0%, transparent 70%), linear-gradient(180deg, #F5F4EF 0%, #FAFAF7 100%); }
#pacerai-homepage .hero-eyebrow { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 16px 6px 8px; background: rgba(39,137,154,0.10); border: 1px solid rgba(39,137,154,0.22); border-radius: 100px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--teal); margin-bottom: 28px; }
#pacerai-homepage .hero-eyebrow .dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--teal); }
#pacerai-homepage h1 { position: relative; z-index: 1; font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: clamp(42px, 6vw, 72px); font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.08; color: var(--white); letter-spacing: -0.01em; max-width: 860px; }
#pacerai-homepage h1 em { font-style: italic; color: var(--teal); }
#pacerai-homepage .hero-sub { position: relative; z-index: 1; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 300; color: var(--text-mid); max-width: 600px; line-height: 1.7; margin: 24px auto 40px; }
#pacerai-homepage .hero-ctas { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }
#pacerai-homepage .btn-lg { padding: 14px 30px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; background: var(--teal); border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: 0.02em; transition: all 0.25s; box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(39,137,154,0.30); }
#pacerai-homepage .btn-lg:hover { background: var(--teal-light); transform: translateY(-2px); }
#pacerai-homepage .btn-outline-lg { padding: 13px 28px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--white); background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.2s; }
#pacerai-homepage .btn-outline-lg:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); }

/* ─── SECTIONS ─── */
#pacerai-homepage .section { padding: 80px 48px; }
#pacerai-homepage .section-inner { max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; }
#pacerai-homepage .section-eyebrow { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 2.5px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--teal); margin-bottom: 12px; }
#pacerai-homepage h2 { font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 44px); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--white); }
#pacerai-homepage h2 em { font-style: italic; color: var(--teal-light); }

/* ─── MISSION CARD ─── */
#pacerai-homepage .mission-card { background: var(--navy-mid); border: 1px solid var(--navy-border); border-left: 3px solid var(--teal); border-radius: 12px; padding: 40px 44px; margin-top: 48px; max-width: 860px; }
#pacerai-homepage .mission-card p { font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: 26px; font-weight: 300; font-style: italic; color: var(--white); line-height: 1.5; }

/* ─── AEO ROW: TEXT AND IMAGE ─── */
#pacerai-homepage .q-section-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 3fr 2fr; gap: 48px; align-items: start; margin-top: 16px; }
#pacerai-homepage .q-section-layout.reverse { grid-template-columns: 2fr 3fr; }
#pacerai-homepage .q-section-layout.reverse .q-visual { order: -1; }
#pacerai-homepage .aeo-snippet { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 300; color: var(--text-mid); line-height: 1.7; margin: 24px 0; padding-left: 20px; border-left: 3px solid var(--teal); }
#pacerai-homepage .question-body { margin-top: 20px; }
#pacerai-homepage .question-body p { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 300; color: var(--text-mid); line-height: 1.7; }
#pacerai-homepage .q-visual:has(img) { background: transparent; border: none; overflow: visible; }
#pacerai-homepage .q-visual img { width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 480px; object-fit: contain; display: block; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; padding: 8px; box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); }

/* ─── PARTNER AVATAR ─── */
#pacerai-homepage .partner-avatar { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; max-width: 200px; border-radius: 50%; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--brand) 0%, var(--teal) 100%); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: 48px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--white); overflow: hidden; }
#pacerai-homepage .partner-avatar img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 50%; }

/* ─── PIPELINE ANIMATION ─── */
@keyframes bounceY { 0%,100%{ transform:translateY(0); } 50%{ transform:translateY(-6px); } }
@keyframes flowDot { 0%{ offset-distance:0%; opacity:0; } 10%{ opacity:1; } 90%{ opacity:1; } 100%{ offset-distance:100%; opacity:0; } }
@keyframes glowPulse { 0%,100%{ box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(39,137,154,0.3), inset 0 0 20px rgba(39,137,154,0.05); } 50%{ box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(39,137,154,0.5), inset 0 0 30px rgba(39,137,154,0.1); } }
@keyframes numStreamFloat { 0%{ transform:translateX(-60px); opacity:0; } 15%{ opacity:0.12; } 85%{ opacity:0.12; } 100%{ transform:translateX(1100px); opacity:0; } }
.pacer-ai-platform { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; }
.pacer-ai-platform .section-eyebrow { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 2.5px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--teal); font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 12px; text-align: center; }
.pacer-ai-platform h2 { font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 44px); font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); line-height: 1.2; text-align: center; }
.pacer-ai-platform h2 em { font-style: italic; color: var(--teal); }
.pacer-ai-platform .section-lead { font-size: 17px; color: var(--text-mid); max-width: 640px; line-height: 1.7; text-align: center; margin: 18px auto 0; }
.pacer-ai-platform .pipeline-visual { position: relative; margin-top: 60px; height: 340px; }
.pacer-ai-platform .pipe-sources { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-around; gap: 12px; width: 120px; z-index: 2; }
.pacer-ai-platform .pipe-icon-box { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--teal); animation: bounceY 3s ease-in-out infinite; }
.pacer-ai-platform .pipe-icon-box:nth-child(2){ animation-delay: .5s; }
.pacer-ai-platform .pipe-icon-box:nth-child(3){ animation-delay: 1s; }
.pacer-ai-platform .pipe-icon-box:nth-child(4){ animation-delay: 1.5s; }
.pacer-ai-platform .pipe-icon-label { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.pacer-ai-platform .pipe-svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; z-index: 1; }
.pacer-ai-platform .flow-path { fill: none; stroke: var(--navy-border); stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-dasharray: 6 4; }
.pacer-ai-platform .flow-dot { position: absolute; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--teal); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(39,137,154,0.6); offset-distance: 0%; animation: flowDot 3s linear infinite; z-index: 3; }
.pacer-ai-platform .flow-dot.d2 { animation-delay: 0.4s; }
.pacer-ai-platform .flow-dot.d3 { animation-delay: 0.8s; }
.pacer-ai-platform .flow-dot.d4 { animation-delay: 1.2s; }

.pacer-ai-platform .flow-dot.out2 { animation-delay: 0.6s; background: var(--teal-light); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(112,196,156,0.6); }
.pacer-ai-platform .flow-dot.out3 { animation-delay: 1.0s; background: var(--teal-light); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(112,196,156,0.6); }
.pacer-ai-platform .pipe-processor { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; transform: translate(-50%,-50%); width: 180px; height: 180px; border-radius: 50%; background: #FFFFFF; border: 2px solid var(--navy-accent); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; z-index: 4; animation: glowPulse 4s ease-in-out infinite; }
.pacer-ai-platform .proc-label { font-family: Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); margin-top: 8px; }
.pacer-ai-platform .proc-label span { color: var(--teal-light); }
.pacer-ai-platform .proc-sub { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.pacer-ai-platform .pipe-outputs { position: absolute; right: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-around; gap: 12px; width: 280px; z-index: 2; align-items: flex-end; }
.pacer-ai-platform .pipe-out-box { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--teal-light); }
.pacer-ai-platform .pipe-out-label { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.pacer-ai-platform .num-stream { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; overflow: hidden; z-index: 0; }
.pacer-ai-platform .num-particle { position: absolute; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--teal); opacity: 0; animation: numStreamFloat 10s linear forwards; white-space: nowrap; }
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .pacer-ai-platform .pipeline-visual { height: auto; flex-direction: column; gap: 32px; padding: 20px 0; display: flex; }
  .pacer-ai-platform .pipe-sources, .pacer-ai-platform .pipe-outputs { position: static; width: 100%; flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; }
  .pacer-ai-platform .pipe-processor { position: static; transform: none; width: 140px; height: 140px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .pacer-ai-platform .pipe-svg { display: none; }
  .pacer-ai-platform .flow-dot { display: none; }
  .pacer-ai-platform .num-stream { display: none; }
}
